name: dbt-agents
description: Authenticated, read-only tools for exploring documented dbt marts in BigQuery.

interface.longDescription: Explore approved dbt marts in BigQuery, search documented tables and columns, inspect schemas, preview bounded samples, estimate query cost, and run guarded read-only SQL. Internal access is limited to approved Google accounts and the configured analytics dataset.
capabilities: Discover approved dbt marts and tables
Inspect schemas and preview bounded samples
Estimate and run guarded read-only queries
defaultPrompt: List the approved dbt marts and the tables I can access.
Search the data dictionary for a metric, then explain the relevant tables and columns.
Estimate and run a bounded read-only query against an approved mart.
